task.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone collectible occult pathway emblem, precision jewelry-grade relief artwork for a card asset library. Original artistic interpretation for the 白塔 / white-tower pathway, NOT a copied official religious emblem. Primary design: An ivory stepped tower whose ascending geometric tiers unfold from two precise open book leaves; architectural analysis made tangible. Porcelain white stone, cobalt-blue inlaid channels and brushed silver edges. Vertical rectangular silhouette, ordered measured openings; no eye, no mechanical gears. Craftsmanship: museum-quality micro-chased metal, layered pierced openwork, satin recesses contrasting polished bevels, restrained precious inlays; rich sculptural depth and genuinely exquisite detail, NOT a flat vector outline or generic app icon. One coherent primary symbol with a bold readable silhouette, not a pile of objects. Straight-on orthographic view, whole emblem centered occupying about 78% of a SQUARE canvas, generous clean margin. Soft upper-left studio illumination; no ground plane or cast shadow outside the object. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, including all internal openwork holes; no black rectangle, no white rectangle, no checkerboard pixels. No text, letters, digits, watermark, card border, human portrait or surrounding scene.
